title: Seven cyclic fields with full anchor and retuned depth budgets

claims.statement: The explicit 7-field degree-143 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-142 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 5825328424677674261866956906469/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=8076852661303420208592268543968882060230120957396040029847151 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(1382315/6832).

experiments.purpose: Check QR profiles, field, orbits, work and the first three signed pair cutoffs (0), the remaining seven pair cutoffs (1), child noise shells and the early proper shells (2), and the full occupancy and error remainder (3). Part zero checks the equivalent cube schedule, fixed-cap work and new memory limit, with eight organizer-counter replays. Child counts and work include all 143 anchor depths with the new literal budget table.
